editorial:
If you like revenge stories with a hard edge, Faster delivers a gritty ride. Dwayne Johnson plays Driver, a man just out of prison who has one goal: track down the crew that killed his brother. There's no fancy plan, just raw determination and a fast car. Along the way, a hitman and a cop chase him, adding extra tension. The movie feels like a throwback to old-school action films, with little humor and lots of attitude. It moves quickly and keeps you locked in.

The action scenes are punchy and well shot, and Johnson brings real weight to the role. The story is simple, which works in its favor, though some side plots feel rushed. If you want deep character study, look elsewhere. But if you want a lean, no-nonsense revenge thriller, this hits the spot. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Driver learns the truth about his brother's death. The cop chasing him reveals that Driver's brother was involved in a setup, and not everyone Driver killed was guilty. The last target is a televangelist who was part of the crew. Driver confronts him but chooses not to kill him, breaking his cycle of revenge. He drives away, finally free from his mission, while the hitman lets him go.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves no-nonsense revenge thrillers and Dwayne Johnson action movies.
